_comment: Inputs of CreateDatacards.py, read by paths.py (CreateDatacards.py and the driver take --paths FILE).
Relative paths are taken from this repository: the defaults assume it sits inside TupleAnalysis, next to
massSpectrum_bckgPrediction. $VARIABLES and ~ are expanded. No production version in the names.
background: the predictions of massSpectrum_bckgPrediction. dir = its output_dir; the files are
dataset = the name of the data file the prediction ran on, without .root.
signals:    per signal model, the directory of the weighted step 1 files (python/Weight.py of
TupleAnalysis) and the file name, with {mass} in GeV.
luminosity: label of the plots (DrawDatacards.py, DrawCompareSignal.py, Significance.py): value in fb^-1
and centre-of-mass energy. The signal files must be weighted with the same luminosity.
